jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. He/she will be working closely with Value and Evidence Networks within our Global Business Unit and with external stakeholders.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you develop and execute on health economics outcomes research (HEOR) & PRO strategies, demonstrating the medical and economic payer-relevant needs to optimize value of BI products.- In this function, you generate evidence that secures optimal market access, successful HTA assessments, optimal pricing, reimbursement and formulary listing for BI products on a global scale.- Additionally, you ensure insights to further inform development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), clinical development plan of our pipeline compounds.- In consideration of regulatory body request and trial development, pre and post launch you will ensure relevant and new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measurement strategies to ensure that the patient perspective is captured in our clinical trial program and interact with regulatory authorities, closely collaborating with other functions.- Besides, you ensure efficient and timely development of key HEOR deliverables (i.e. payer value stories, payer engagement tools, GVDs, economic models, retrospective database analyses, indirect comparisons, real world evidence data) for assigned BI products.- Finally, yet importantly, you develop and maintain relevant partnerships with payers, academic research institutions, contract research organizations and other HEOR thought leaders in order to optimize the impact of HEOR & PRO research.Additional responsibilities as Senior Manager:- You will define long-term global development strategies for the assets, in close collaboration with the global Marketing and global Medical counterparts, to ensure optimal patient access.- In addition, you will draft long-term publication strategies, considering the long-term global market development.Requirements- Graduate degree, preferably PhD in health economics, Medicine (MD), public health, pharmacy, focusing on Health Technology Assessment, PRO, Pharmacy, Medicine, Public Health- Several years of pharma industry experience, with positions in areas of relevance for HEOR, PRO consulting or payer authorities- Multiple years of direct experience undertaking Health Technology Assessments (HTA) & PRO including Evaluations for Regulatory and health authority interventions of pharmaceutical products- Conducting or being part of a team working on non-interventional studies and RWE programs- Demonstrated experience of successful regulatory, reimbursement negotiations for launching new products in key markets- Proven track record of delivering value demonstration materials that resulted in timely patient access and adoption- Proven ability in appraising clinical evidence (both RCTs and operational evidence)- Profound knowledge and expertise to formulating COA strategies including validation methods, administration of measures and statistical analyses of COA data- Excellent communication and influencing skill both in internal and external contextAdditional requirements as Senior HEOR Manager:- Long-term pharma industry experience, with positions in the areas of health economics, pricing & reimbursement, consulting, or payer authorities- Several years of exposure to international business on a day-to-day basis- Strong track record in value generation, demonstration and/or communication- Highly experienced in conducting health economics/outcomes research across multiple specialty disciplines (e.g. patient reported outcomes, health economic modelling, real world data generation)For employees with a current contract of limited duration, legal / labor agreement requirements for contract extension will be considered.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿Ready to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team,Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or per mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comPlease submit your application documents in English.
